scope.method: Read-only consistency review of the audit's recorded official npm package pages, upstream release notes, v26 source manifests, and the official compatibility issue against the planned synthetic fixture.

verifiedConclusions.claim: The official npm package pages identify quicktype and quicktype-core as version 26.0.0, declare Apache-2.0, and report respectively 16 and 13 direct dependency names.
verifiedConclusions.basis: The audit records those package-page fields and links the official npm pages.

verifiedConclusions.claim: The v26.0.0 upstream release notes state Node.js >=20.19.0 for the CLI and core embedders; the core source manifest at the tag declares >=20.0.0.
verifiedConclusions.basis: The audit distinguishes the release-note requirement from the source-manifest field and leaves the published core engine field unresolved.

verifiedConclusions.claim: The v26 source manifests show version 24.0.0, while the v24 release notes describe release-version stamping during npm publication; this is a plausible explanation for the observed discrepancy, not direct verification of v26 tarball contents.
verifiedConclusions.basis: The audit labels the explanation as plausible and explicitly says the release notes do not verify exact v26 tarball contents.

verifiedConclusions.claim: Upstream issue #2856 reports a Rust generation crash for a boolean JSON Schema const with quicktype-core 23.2.6. The issue page is closed and lists no branches or pull requests; this documents a version-specific risk report, but does not establish whether quicktype-core 26.0.0 is affected or fixed.
verifiedConclusions.basis: The official issue states version 23.2.6 and boolean const in its description, and its Development section lists no branches or pull requests. T06's synthetic boolean/numeric const fixture remains planned and NOT_RUN, gated on selecting and pinning the schema/generator/validator route.

limitations: Exact npm tarball integrity hashes, byte sizes, archive file lists, published dependency ranges, and resolved recursive dependency inventory remain unavailable.
Direct and transitive dependency license notices, optional/platform-specific dependencies, and the quicktype input packages' transitive closures have not been audited.
The published quicktype-core engine field and exact internal dependency versions in the v26 tarballs were not retrieved.

PowerShell requests to the registry failed TLS and browser registry navigation returned ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT. The proposed app.unpkg.com route was rejected by auto-review, so no alternate mirror was used.
No package was installed, no lockfile was generated or changed, and generator compatibility was not exercised.
selectionDecision: Audit-only evidence is adequate for the limited upstream identity, declared package license, direct dependency count/name, release-note runtime floor, and source-tag observations above. It does not establish supply-chain closure or justify selecting/freezing quicktype; retain the candidate as unselected pending exact tarball metadata, recursive license review, and generator compatibility review.
